SELECT status FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id AS doctor_id, department_id, status AS doctor_status FROM doctor WHERE id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department_name FROM doctor_schedule s LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = s.department_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT FROM doctor_schedule s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = s.department_id AND dep.deleted = 0 AND dep.status = 1 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.start_time > DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL s.cancel_before_minutes MINUTE)
SELECT id FROM doctor_schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM doctor_schedule WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
